raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

[#36267](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36267) removed Qwen3.5 GDN prefill projection unpack copies on CUDA by keeping Q/K/V/Z/B/A as strided views. ROCm still materialized those tensors despite already having stride-aware consumers. ROCm also split QKV and then launched `l2norm_fwd` twice per GDN layer.

This PR ports the view path to ROCm and folds Q/K normalization plus GDN gating into the QKV split. Profiling then showed that the recurrent `chunk_h`/`chunk_o` kernels dominated the remaining GDN time. Their fixed launch geometry under-filled MI355X, while NVIDIA can route GDN prefill through specialized FlashInfer/CuTeDSL backends. This PR therefore adds gfx95-aware Triton launch selection while preserving the original configuration for other platforms, KDA, and unsupported shapes.

The norm fusion differs from [#33290](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33290) and closed [#28361](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28361): those reduce two norm launches to one; this PR reduces them to zero by normalizing while Q/K are already in registers. [#37113](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37113) is the complementary decode projection/Conv1D fusion; its decode branch is mutually exclusive with this prefill path.

## Modifications

- Enable Qwen3.5's strided projection views on ROCm for non-speculative extend. Speculative extend/verify retain the existing unpack path.
- Add `fused_gdn_prefill_prepare`, which in one launch:
  - splits strided post-conv Q/K/V,
  - L2-normalizes Q/K in fp32,
  - passes V through unchanged,
  - computes fp32 GDN `g`/`beta` from strided A/B views.
- Surface `chunk_gated_delta_rule`'s existing `use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel` switch through `TritonGDNKernel.extend`.
- Harden non-power-of-two TP-local Q/K head counts by padding both reduction axes and masking padded loads/stores.
- Select AMD GDN `chunk_h` BV from launch-grid coverage and use deeper pipelining for long per-sequence recurrences. Explicit env overrides remain available; non-AMD and KDA retain prior defaults.
- For AMD GDN `K=V=128`, tune `chunk_o` to `BK=64`, `BV=128`, two warps, and three stages. Replace its zero-filled output allocation with `empty_like`, since every valid output element is overwritten.
- Register the existing chunk launch overrides in `environ.py`. No new user-facing option.

## Accuracy Tests

On MI355X, `test_gdn_prefill_layout.py` passes **7 tests / 10 subtests**, covering:

- BF16 and FP16,
- Qwen3.5 TP2 dimensions,
- non-power-of-two Q/K heads,
- empty batches,
- transposed post-conv and strided A/B layouts,
- exact V/g/beta parity,
- Q/K agreement with `l2norm_fwd`,
- GDN-only `chunk_h`/`chunk_o` selector contracts and fallback behavior.

GSM8K, full 1,319-question split, 5-shot, greedy, TP2, two runs per arm:

| Arm | Run 1 | Run 2 | Pooled |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline (pre-PR) | 0.928 | 0.922 | 0.9249 |
| This PR | 0.917 | 0.922 | 0.9196 |

The 0.53pp pooled gap is 0.72σ and does not resolve an accuracy difference. After the new recurrence tuning, a separate no-thinking chat-mode confirmation scores 0.974.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

### Environment

- 8× MI355X (`gfx950`)
- `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.19-rocm720-mi35x-20260913`
- Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MXFP4
- AITER unified attention, Triton linear attention
- FP8 E4M3 KV, page size 16, radix cache disabled
- EAGLE: 3 steps, top-k 1, 4 draft tokens
- chunked prefill size 16,384
- InferenceX fixed-length synthetic workload shaped as 70K input / 300 output; this is not an AgentX replay

### Kernel benchmark and attribution

Matched TP2 70K torch-profiler traces contain 225 GDN-layer launches (45 layers × 5 prefill chunks):

| Kernel / shape | Before | After | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `chunk_h`, profile total | 236.08 ms | 123.11 ms | **−47.9%** |
| `chunk_o`, TP2 16K | 0.208 ms | 0.151 ms | **−27.5%** |
| `chunk_o`, TP4 16K | 0.109 ms | 0.076 ms | **−30.7%** |
| `chunk_o`, TP2/TP4 4,464-token tail | 0.052 / 0.031 ms | 0.045 / 0.027 ms | **−14.3% / −14.0%** |

The standalone gating kernel disappears. Its 3.63 ms trace cost is absorbed by a prepare kernel increase from 12.71 to 14.87 ms, for a net 1.47 ms saving over the 70K request.

### End-to-end serving

Each result compares the pre-PR upstream baseline with this PR. Throughput is total tokens per second per GPU (input plus output, divided by TP). C1 rows use mirrored same-GPU-pair ordering; negative TTFT and positive throughput deltas are improvements.

| TP | Conc | Baseline TTFT | This PR TTFT | Δ TTFT | Baseline tok/s/GPU | This PR tok/s/GPU | Δ |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 | 1 | 2549.4 ms | **2471.7 ms** | **−3.05%** | 3312 | **3322** | **+0.31%** |
| 2 | 4 | 2650.2 ms | **2573.4 ms** | **−2.90%** | 7619 | **7755** | **+1.78%** |
| 2 | 8 | 4417.3 ms | 4416.7 ms | −0.42% | 9680 | **9882** | **+2.09%** |
| 4 | 1 | 1754.6 ms | **1685.0 ms** | **−3.97%** | 1759 | **1772** | **+0.70%** |
| 4 | 4 | 1845.3 ms | **1802.5 ms** | **−2.32%** | 4664 | **4734** | **+1.50%** |
| 4 | 8 | 3283.8 ms | **3176.9 ms** | **−2.77%** | 6327 | **6475** | **+2.35%** |

TP2 concurrency 8 pools four GPU pairs, with the two GPUs 2+0 runs averaged first. Its TTFT delta is the mean of the four pair ratios; the TTFT columns are the averaged medians, which sit 0.5 ms apart. Total throughput was higher on every pair. TPOT is within +0.56% at TP2 C1 and +0.03% at TP4 C1; flat decode metrics are expected for a prefill-only optimization. TP2 C4 includes the tuned `chunk_o` launch but predates the final `empty_like` cleanup. TP4 C4/C8 predate both `chunk_o` changes and are therefore conservative. TP4 C8 has substantial queue-order variance; the table reports the mirrored crossover.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [formatting guide](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [testing guide](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A: no new public option.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code-style guidance.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process.
2. Obtain CODEOWNER and reviewer approvals.
3. Trigger required CI tests.
4. Merge after green CI and required approvals.

+def fused_gdn_prefill_prepare(
+    mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    A_log: torch.Tensor,
+    a: torch.Tensor,
+    b: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    num_qk_heads: int,
+    num_v_heads: int,
+    head_qk: int,
+    head_v: int,
+    eps: float = 1e-6,
+):
+    """Split/normalize QKV and prepare GDN gates in a single launch.

+    assert a.shape == b.shape == (seq_len, num_v_heads)
+    assert a.stride(1) == b.stride(1) == 1

+        (1, seq_len, num_qk_heads, head_qk),
+        dtype=mixed_qkv.dtype,
+        device=mixed_qkv.device,
+    )
+    k = torch.empty_like(q)
+    v = torch.empty(

+        g,

+        A_log,

+        NUM_V_HEADS_POW2=triton.next_power_of_2(num_v_heads),
